title: An open date picker on a tile stays with its tile
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the Revenue tile's date pill so the picker opens.
  3. With the pointer over the open picker, scroll the mouse wheel down and then up.
  4. Look at the picker and the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The page does not scroll.
  • Step 4: The picker stays attached under the Revenue tile's pill; it does not float away from its tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S12-R9 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 13 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, one rule per defect ticket SV-10936; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14); read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
